ValidationRule.description: This rule will fire when user tries to edit any Amount or date related fields after creation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISCHANGED(Amount_Paid__c), ISCHANGED(Principal_Applied__c), ISCHANGED(Interest_Applied__c), ISCHANGED(Tax_on_Interest__c), ISCHANGED(Excess_Payment__c), ISCHANGED(Date_Of_Payment__c), ISCHANGED(Company_Bank_Account__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit the receipts after creation to continue please cancel this receipt and create a new one.
